title: Can I SURVIVE Spell Chess?
summary: Chess.com Spell Chess vs online humans (~1500-1630). Each player has 2 Jump spells and 5 Freeze spells. Freeze immobilizes all pieces in a 3x3 area; Jump lets a piece jump over another piece. Spells recharge for three turns. King capture decides the game. Tony wins game 1 (counter-freeze tactics, ~3:12), plays game 2 (spell-stacking chaos), and wins game 3 with a jump spell over f7 capturing the king (~12:20, +13 rating).
rules: Each player: 2 Jump spells and 5 Freeze spells (inventory shown as green jump potion x2 and blue freeze potion x5).
Freeze spell: cast on a square as part of your turn; all pieces in the 3x3 area centred there are frozen (cannot move) for the opponent's next turn; it wears off after.
Jump spell: cast on a piece so that a sliding piece can jump over it (move through one occupied square) this turn.
A spell needs three turns to recharge before that spell type can be used again.
King capture: you can capture the enemy king (no check/checkmate safety); spells can enable king captures.
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king (or checkmate/flag); goal: win one game (won 2+).
